saved mask comes from the C12 script (copied in C13), which reads /tmp/sub.npz from C10 (the full 60x60 region; days 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 and 2009-06-01..08-31). It builds per-cell hazen 90th-percentile thresholds from contiguous ±5-day index windows, smooths them over 31 days, and compares the target days against thr_s[Dt].
